subject.title: improve(ios): guide first-run users into gateway onboarding

question: Should maintainers adopt and rebase this preview-onboarding feature on top of the current iOS onboarding/security flow, or close/narrow it instead?
rationale: The PR has strong proof and a useful feature idea, but it is protected, conflicts with newer main changes, and changes upgrade-sensitive onboarding behavior; automation cannot choose the product direction or conflict resolution safely.

options.title: Adopt and rebase preview onboarding
options.body: Preserve the preview/sample-mode value while replaying it onto current main's setup-link staging, branded typography, and security setup copy.

options.title: Narrow to preview data only
options.body: Keep only the renamed preview fixture/sample data and defer first-run onboarding UX to a separate maintainer-designed change.

options.title: Close as product direction not accepted
options.body: Decline bundled preview onboarding for now and leave current main's Gateway onboarding flow as the supported path.

recommendation.title: Adopt and rebase preview onboarding
recommendation.body: Preserve the preview/sample-mode value while replaying it onto current main's setup-link staging, branded typography, and security setup copy.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent current-main onboarding/routing changes are the immediate conflict surface that any adoption must preserve.
